```{r setup, include=FALSE}

library(tidyverse)
library(reshape)

```

```{r}
##Adding scatter plots for mESC correlations

##Remake the correlation matrix using new HEK293T-synHEK3 data

HEK293T_synHEK3_Replicate_Edit_Scores <- read_csv("/Users/troymcdiarmid/Documents/U6_pro_series/Figs/Pub_Figs/FigS14_Final_Figure_Datasets/AllU6_HEK293T_synHEK3_Edit_Scores_by_Replicate.csv")  %>% 
  select(Name = Seq_Name, HEK293T_Rep_1_Normalized_Edit_Score = Replicate_1_BC_Normalized_Edit_Score, HEK293T_Rep_2_Normalized_Edit_Score = Replicate_2_BC_Normalized_Edit_Score, HEK293T_Rep_3_Normalized_Edit_Score = Replicate_3_BC_Normalized_Edit_Score, HEK293T_Rep_4_Normalized_Edit_Score = Replicate_4_BC_Normalized_Edit_Score)
  
  
##Read in replicate data

Replicate_Edit_Scores_U6 <- read_csv("/Users/troymcdiarmid/Documents/U6_pro_series/Figs/Pub_Figs/FigS14_Final_Figure_Datasets/AllU6_pBC_Filtered_iBC_Normalized_Replicate_Edit_Scores_Comparison_Table.csv")

##Remove old HEK239T data and replace with new 

Replicate_Edit_Scores_U6 <- Replicate_Edit_Scores_U6 %>% 
  select(!HEK293T_Rep_1_Normalized_Edit_Score:HEK293T_Rep_2_Normalized_Edit_Score)

Replicate_Edit_Scores_U6 <- Replicate_Edit_Scores_U6 %>% 
  left_join(HEK293T_synHEK3_Replicate_Edit_Scores, by = "Name")

##Removing the four sequences that did not meet Lmax < 40 

Replicate_Edit_Scores_U6 <- Replicate_Edit_Scores_U6 %>% 
  filter(!Name %in% c("Salmo_salar_RNU6-8_ENSSSAG00000015687", "Callorhinchus_milii_RNU6-8_ENSCMIG00000009541", "Rhinolophus_ferrumequinum_ENSRFEG00010003483", "Weissman_sU6-2"))


##Convert NAs to zeros

Replicate_Edit_Scores_U6  <- Replicate_Edit_Scores_U6  %>% replace(is.na(.), 0)


##Add colour labels and reordering factor for plotting

hRNU61_Promoter <- Replicate_Edit_Scores_U6 %>% 
  filter(Name == "Human_Weissman_RNU6-1")
hRNU61_Promoter$Promoter_Lib <- "hRNU61"

SynU6_Promoters <- Replicate_Edit_Scores_U6 %>% 
  filter(grepl("Syn", Name))
SynU6_Promoters$Promoter_Lib <- "Synthetic"

DivU6_Promoters <- Replicate_Edit_Scores_U6 %>% 
  filter(!grepl("Syn", Name)) %>% 
  filter(!Name %in% c("Human_Weissman_RNU6-1", "Weissman_mU6"))
DivU6_Promoters$Promoter_Lib <- "Diverse"

mU6_Promoter <- Replicate_Edit_Scores_U6 %>% 
  filter(Name == "Weissman_mU6")
mU6_Promoter$Promoter_Lib <- "Weissman_mU6"

Replicate_Edit_Scores_U6 <- rbind(SynU6_Promoters, DivU6_Promoters, mU6_Promoter, hRNU61_Promoter)

Replicate_Edit_Scores_U6$Promoter_Lib <- factor(Replicate_Edit_Scores_U6$Promoter_Lib, levels = c("Synthetic", "Diverse", "Weissman_mU6", "hRNU61"))

ggplot(Replicate_Edit_Scores_U6, aes(x = log2(HEK293T_Rep_1_Normalized_Edit_Score), y = log2(HEK293T_Rep_2_Normalized_Edit_Score), colour = Promoter_Lib, size = Promoter_Lib)) +
  geom_point() +
  scale_color_manual(values=c("#D2D5D5", "#56B4E9","#56B4E9", "black")) +
  scale_size_manual(values=c(4, 4, 4, 6)) +
  scale_x_continuous(labels = scales::number_format(accuracy = 0.1)) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::number_format(accuracy = 0.1)) +
  theme_classic() +
  theme(axis.line = element_line(colour = 'black', size = 0.8)) +
  theme(axis.ticks = element_line(colour = "black", size = 0.8)) +
  theme(axis.ticks.length=unit(.2, "cm")) +
  labs(title = "", x = "", y = "") +
  theme(legend.position = "none") +
  theme(text = element_text(family="Arial", colour = "black", size = 39), plot.margin = margin(0, 15, 0, 20)) 
  ggsave("HEK293T_Rep1_HEK293TsynHEK3_Rep2_Corr.jpeg", width = 9, height = 7, path = "/Users/troymcdiarmid/Documents/U6_pro_series/Figs/Pub_Figs/")
  
ggplot(Replicate_Edit_Scores_U6, aes(x = log2(HEK293T_Rep_1_Normalized_Edit_Score), y = log2(HEK293T_Rep_3_Normalized_Edit_Score), colour = Promoter_Lib, size = Promoter_Lib)) +
```
